_hand: HAND-WRITTEN — the one registry entry that does NOT come from daedalus's Apply flow. Same entry schema as one apps.json value, read by daedalus.nix through stacks/apps/registry-lib.nix. daedalus is declared here rather than in the registry because an Apply that broke its entry would take down the interface you would use to undo it. Editing this file IS the workflow; rebuild to apply. The hostname overrides the derived default because bare daedalus.toscanini.me is the project's public landing page (a hand-managed CNAME to GitHub Pages) — the app takes daedalus-app so the two names never collide anywhere: pi-hole, traefik, or the tunnel's route-sync.

notes.app: The control plane itself. Declared by hand in stacks/daedalus/self.json rather than in the registry: an Apply that broke this entry would take down the interface you would use to undo it.
notes.source: source.mode = "local" — the source lives in the flake repo at stacks/daedalus/app and is bind-mounted into the container, which runs the Vite dev server against it. Saving a file is the whole deploy.
